purpose: 静态模型服务构图比较，不是交互或业务验证

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity desktop application screenshot for Whomi settings at 1440x1000, crisp Chinese UI, no laptop frame or external decorations. Established Operate interface: system sans Segoe UI/Microsoft YaHei, white surfaces, #f5f7f9 canvas, #26303d text, #5c6674 secondary, #e0e5eb borders, restrained orange #b83b12 active/focus, 10px control corners, 48px targets. Input image1 is Whomi's current real page (reference visual language); images2/3 are original symbol/wordmark, preserve faithfully at top-left, never invent new branding. Internal settings ONLY 模型服务 / 消息处理 / 关于我们. Real-looking layout, but clear small top notice 静态概念稿 · 示例数据. Model settings: title 模型服务; service provider list with search 服务商搜索, selected 示例云服务, 示例本地服务, 自定义服务; 添加服务商 action. Detail header 示例云服务 and enabled switch labeled 启用; 连接配置 section with 服务商名称 field, 连接协议 dropdown OpenAI 兼容, 接口地址 value https://api.example.invalid/v1, 密钥 field with obscured bullets and eye icon. 检测连接 secondary button with 未检测 · 演示 status. Model section heading 模型 with 2 个示例模型, 同步模型 primary action, 手动添加 secondary. Rows 示例模型 A and 示例模型 B, each subtitle 示例云服务 and edit/remove icons. Footer inline guidance 使用云模型时，相关材料会发送给所配置的服务商。 Keep actions grouped, no fake save success, no enterprise/login/subscription, no fake user or stats. One clear primary action, plenty of readable white space but compact task UI.
A 专注分栏. Full-window dedicated settings replaces app business navigation. Left white settings sidebar 200px: original logo top, 返回上一页 beneath, large 设置 title, three vertical categories. Middle provider list column 230px with search top and add bottom. Right flexible configuration surface with 36px padding; connection form uses stacked labels, two fields on first line then address and key full width; model list below. Three coherent columns separated by fine single lines. Category 模型服务 active pale orange. This should look calm and focused, effortless provider switching.
